raw_text: Use the 'Async' suffix for all async methods; match synchronous counterparts; return `Task<T>`/`Task`; consider `ValueTask<T>`; avoid `void` except event handlers. Use try/catch around await; don't swallow exceptions; `ConfigureAwait(false)` in libraries; `Task.FromException()`; `Task.WhenAll()`/`Task.WhenAny()`; avoid needless async/await; cancellation tokens. Never use `.Wait()`, `.Result`, or `.GetAwaiter().GetResult()` in async code. Avoid blocking; Don't create async void methods (except for event handlers); Always await Task-returning methods; async command pattern; `IAsyncEnumerable<T>`; TAP. Review and suggest improvements.
